findings.detail: Transferred vector-valued source probe outputs already index source i. Only own target and native target priors are gathered once with pi_i-1; code checks label equality and AUROC invariance.
Identity/complement/inverse/shuffle map methods all score the same target inverse state and inverse fit-only mean. They do not substitute wrong-transform centering.

Step0 target and fixed-point target use the same trained source/probe with separately fitted validation-only maps and their own inverse fit means. They are distinct named methods, not an initial-source phase.
Uses original orbit-separated source fit/dev/eligible rules. Matched sensitivity requires native D(pi) and D(Cpi) counts both equal E(pi); inverse count equality is exact.

Cached native-vocabulary predictions scored against own oracle count on identity and target inverse; length-mode derived only from native training task counts; transform column preserves distinct scopes.

Unconditional priors validation-fit only; oracle-count priors explicitly separate. Summary common controls exclude both priors, direct, own, step0 and fixed-point, and maximize each scalar control after fixed21 equal-length mean.
Reuses saved rotations byte-for-byte and unchanged source/own fitters; checks all22 trained vendor rows before exporting common-input scores, with fixed1e-12 tolerance.
Undefined samples counted; any undefined length gives undefined scalar. Summary never zero-fills/reweights undefined lengths or treats shuffle seeds as independent units.
